headline: Beijing solicits AI cyber-defense research and adversarial test-platform proposals
summary: Beijing’s science and technology commission opened a 2026 call for AI-enabled cybersecurity-defense research proposals. It has two tracks: enterprise-led AI defense products and a high-fidelity adversarial test platform led by universities or research institutes. The company track requires at least 2:1 matching funds and limits projects to one year; applications close Oct 29, 2026 at 18:00. The notice reports no award amounts, selected teams, research outputs or measured defenses.
